title: Millennium Tower, Vienna
visualBrief: Two interlocking cylindrical glazed office volumes, projecting service spine, narrow silver mullions and glass spandrels, recessed entry columns, stepped lamella-screened hood, sloping glass crown and paired braced antenna masts.

assembly.method: Repeated facade geometry uses EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing; canonical shared surfaces contain no embedded bitmap copies.

nativeAxes.longitudinal: +X between cylindrical lobes in cached map frame
nativeAxes.front: -Z at the concave facade seam; +Z toward projecting rear service spine
nativeAxes.origin: Cached mapped envelope center at ground datum

reconstruction.basis: Individual deterministic reconstruction from owner architecture and office plan, Podrecca exterior and facade photographs, architect descriptions and exact-QID OSM footprint. Floor elevations, crown tiers, mullion dimensions, entrance layout and mast sections are reconstructed, not measured construction drawings.
reconstruction.bodyHeightBasis: OSM height tag interpreted as cylindrical body based on photographed stepped profile; requires an elevation drawing.

geographicProposal.reviewStatus: signed exact-QID twin-lobe and projecting service-spine review
geographicProposal.orientationConfidence: asymmetric exact polygon plus owner plan/architect photos; door and terrain datums approximate
geographicProposal.notes: Fresh exact Q80495 OSM way 105310525 independently confirms the twin-lobe outline and asymmetric projecting rear service spine; same ring matches cached reprojection within 0.002 m rounding. Retain anchor [16.38702191,48.240306985] and heading -0.151859229319: native +X ENE bearing 81.30 degrees, -Z NNW bearing 351.30 degrees at the concave seam and +Z SSE bearing 171.30 degrees at the projecting spine. The asymmetric spine, rather than a rectangle-only guess, fixes the sign. Actually inspected owner typical office plan shows two circular lobes and a projecting rectangular service wing, and architect street/river photographs show the taller spine and paired masts rising at that wing above the curved stepped hood. Exact door positions and lobby layout are schematic; the front seam doors are an exterior reconstruction, not a verified sole public entrance. Fresh ring is roughly 43 by 35 m; independently fitted circular arcs retain 0.189/0.129 m RMS radial residuals recorded by the original study. No height stretching to the 140.5 m map tag: owner overall 202 m and published abstract 30 m antenna imply working 172 m spine, with intermediate 140.5 m cylinder /153.4 m hood photographic stages. Actual mall junctions, river footbridge and pavement grade are outside this tower-only asset. Footprint replacement remains disabled.

scaleBasis: Published owner/architect/contractor heights and distinguishing construction systems; map footprint for local orientation, with reconstructed details declared separately.
geometrySource: Original deterministic exterior geometry; no downloaded meshes or copied photographic textures. Footprint-derived registration includes separately attributed OpenStreetMap evidence.
sourceLicense: Original reconstruction under repository license. Map-derived plan evidence: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL-1.0. Reference publications are linked, not redistributed.
materialMethod: Canonical shared material graphs bound through molenSurface extras with metric coordinates divided by central repeat meters. Vertex colors provide component tint. Glass retains opaque metallic-roughness PBR; no bitmap texture copies per model.
reviewStatus: source-geometry; near/far and shared-material captures pending
limitations: Original detailed instanced master remains exactly reproducible at 2518992 bytes, sha256:9b5fe07fede15c7a47aee383c0e988589cfb4da45ba0a2d2cef9076b7ea63307, 268856 expanded /30296 stored triangles in four parts and 84 placements. It is retained as the detailed source; separate browser variants use authored geometry instead of loading it as the default model. Four levels preserve twin fitted cylinders and concave front seam, projecting service spine, setback glass hood/lamella screen, sloped crown and paired braced 202 m masts. Skyline combines measured canonical graph means and an area-weighted glazing/spandrel colour into one opaque draw, with tower-only pavement and coarse mast bracing. District corrects the older 153.4 m solid hood cap to the 150.4 m roof below separate coarse 150.6/151.4/152.2 m lamella bands, with grouped floor rhythm and coarse mast bracing; street coarsens curved-panel pitch; close keeps the 1.4 m working grid, fine metal mullions/transoms, reconstructed glazed ground floor and support columns, hood fins and mast sections. Two canonical shared metal_painted and metal_stainless graphs plus opaque glazing/recess palette provide four near groups and zero embedded images. The 50-floor owner program, 140.5 m OSM tag, working 41 cylinder rows at 3.25 m spacing, 153.4 m hood and 172 m spine are deliberately distinguished: intermediate tiers and floor subdivisions are photographic reconstructions, not surveyed elevations. Hood radius/setbacks, sloping roof, lamella brackets, column/door positions, mast dimensions and exact renovated lobby are unmeasured. Ground-floor doors remain schematic closed glazing; passage through the adjoining mall is outside this exterior asset. Separate Millennium City mall/housing/river footbridge, office interiors, actual terrain grade and roof plant are not modeled. No third-party photograph or plan is embedded or redistributed. Physical phone/laptop dense-city measurements remain pending.
